raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Scan the image from top to bottom and left to right. Count the three implicit C-Cl bonds in CCl3, then the bond from the CCl3 carbon to the central carbon. Count the central C=N bond to HN, the N-to-lower-carbon bond, the R-to-lower-carbon bond, the lower C=C bond, the bond from that alkene carbon to the carbonyl carbon, the C=O bond, and the carbonyl-carbon-to-R1 bond. Omit the N-H bond and all curved arrows. The resulting inventory contains 11 non-hydrogen bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态有机结构，顶部有一个 CCl3 基团，CCl3 的碳向下连接到中心碳；左侧标有 HN，氮与中心碳相连，并且还向下连接到一个下方碳骨架；下方左侧有 R 取代基连接到烯烃片段；右侧有一个羰基 C=O，羰基碳还连接到 R1。图中还有几条弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；氢相关键也不计入。

推理计数：按从上到下、从左到右计数非氢键。CCl3 中有 3 个隐含的 C-Cl 键，计 3。CCl3 的碳到中心碳有 1 个键，累计 4。中心碳到 HN 中氮的 C=N 键计 1，累计 5。氮到下方碳的键计 1，累计 6。R 到下方碳的键计 1，累计 7。下方 C=C 键计 1，累计 8。该烯烃碳到羰基碳的键计 1，累计 9。羰基 C=O 键计 1，累计 10。羰基碳到 R1 的键计 1，累计 11。省略 N-H 键和所有箭头，因此总数为 11。
